name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: SMB SaaS Sales Leader | Team Leadership, AE Coaching & Enablement, Pipeline & Forecasting
summary: SMB SaaS seller and team leader with 15+ years in sales, onboarding, and account management, including back-to-back team lead roles at Wix and Fetch & Funnel. At Wix, led a team of 20 (later 8) for two years, helped hire and train new team members, and built sales training for tenured account executives on a new vertical that went from proof of concept to profitable, while personally holding 120% of sales targets. Ranked top three in sales at Accelo on a team that grew from 8 to 15 reps while quota roughly doubled, so I know what separates a top rep from the middle of the board. Coaches to a repeatable process: clean pipeline, honest forecasts, and consultative selling that ties the product to the customer's revenue.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Run the full sales cycle for SMB clients, from outbound and discovery through pricing, close, and expansion, and consult with owners on driving revenue from their systems.
Built an outbound engine that scored 180+ businesses' digital footprint and triggered personalized outreach, a repeatable top-of-funnel motion.
Build sales pipelines, lead routing, and reporting in GoHighLevel and HubSpot, the infrastructure a sales team runs and forecasts on.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Led multi-stakeholder accounts across creative, media, and technology teams, running QBRs and turning results into expansion recommendations.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Sold, trained, and managed 15-20 SMB-focused reseller partners (deals ~$10K-$45K), enabling their teams to sell the product, and retained all but one (~94%).

experience.title: Sales Team Lead (Account Executive / Sales Operations)
bullets: Led the sales team while carrying my own number, closing 6 new-client deals averaging ~$22K (several over $25K), roughly $130K+ in total bookings.
Built internal sales and reporting processes that improved accuracy, reduced handoff errors, and strengthened alignment between sales and delivery.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Led and developed a team for two years (20, later 8), overseeing budgets, scope, and delivery for a high-value SMB portfolio.
Contributed to hiring, onboarding, and training new team members, and developed sales training for tenured account executives.
Drove team initiatives and process improvements for a brand-new vertical that grew from proof of concept to a profitable business line.
Held 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets while launching 25+ SMB clients per month.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Ranked top three in sales on a team that grew from 8 to 15 reps while quota roughly doubled, earning consistently into accelerator tiers.
Averaged ~$17,750/month in services bookings (~$213K annualized) plus new recurring revenue, selling SaaS to SMB agencies and professional-services firms.

bullets: Ran full-cycle, high-volume SMB SaaS sales: prospecting, qualification, demos, and close.
